policy: Keep raw statuses, isolate Vitest deadline detections, and qualify any behavioral equivalence by the stated input and ownership contract.

classifications.definition inventory projection: Definitions are sorted and version summaries scoped to their owner. Descriptions and static labels are optional operator presentation fields.
classifications.operator signal validation: Unknown execution/definition/signal, validation policy, empty idempotency keys and repeated delivery are exercised through the storage boundary. Optional undefined metadata and diagnostic wording remain raw.
classifications.diagnostic text: Tests assert the durable effect, error class and structured error fields where contractual. Exact human-readable wording remains flexible.
classifications.operator retry instrumentation: A durable retry is idempotent and remains successful if instrumentation throws. Optional observability shape and raw messages can differ.
classifications.operator existence boundary: Missing deployed definitions and undeclared signals reject before writes. Exact diagnostics may differ.
classifications.durable wait projection: JSON objects, primitive or malformed historical options, and missing/zero timeout values have distinct direct tests. JSON cannot durably encode NaN or Infinity with the default codec. Custom adapters still need to preserve the payload contract.
classifications.durable graph projection: Execution, signal and command nodes and their links are asserted with typed durable history. Parent command-less fallbacks and optional graph timestamps are separate presentation fields.
classifications.atomic start and client observations: An invalid request prevents the entire write, incomplete adapter results reject, heterogeneous order and idempotent reuse are covered. Concurrency return-existing can legally return another execution ID. Residual optional metadata or observation shape does not change that contract.
classifications.terminal status and codec contract: Completed outputs, failed and cancelled errors and malformed/nonterminal replies are distinguished. Metadata fallback is synthesized for malformed adapter records and does not change the terminal state. Typed result validation remains separate from durable storage.
classifications.typed signal metadata: Declared signal identity, validation, empty key rejection and deduplication are exercised. Optional undefined metadata can differ in property shape.
classifications.version and definition attachment: Both versions are boundary-checked, and compatible older executions attach. Diagnostic formatting has no effect on which durable execution can be attached.
classifications.cursor format: Native Date milliseconds are padded and database microseconds round-trip exactly. The Date ISO output is always UTC; alternative end anchors can agree within that domain.
classifications.guarded version recovery: Missing and incompatible executions fail before storage. Compatible recovery commits only a matching version-blocked execution. Diagnostic bounds and optional representation may differ for an absent definition.

vitestDeadlineKills.reason:
Test timed out in 5000ms.
If this is a long-running test, pass a timeout value as the last argument or configure it globally with "testTimeout".
vitestDeadlineKills.corroboratingInvariant: Removing this deletion retains a settled preparation forever. Bounded tests independently require delayed validation and both parallel encoding orders to publish their commands and finish the activation.

classifications.scoped context and durable value project: The variant changes diagnostic metadata, optional field shape or a guard at an internal conversion boundary. Keep the raw evidence and its exact source site for future semantic changes.
classifications.diagnostic text: Tests assert the durable effect, error class and structured error fields where contractual. Exact human-readable wording remains flexible.
classifications.signal replay and optional deadlines: Declared signal and persisted-result parsing are exercised. Optional timeouts and malformed payload guards retain their raw statuses.
classifications.child command metadata and output: Child concurrency and identity are optional durable fields, and output schemas are validated when present. Existing child-path suites exercise lifecycle; optional shape and direct context fallback remain separately visible.
classifications.continuation and cancellation fences: Scheduler continuation and cancellation histories are exercised. The independent repeat-call guard depends on explicit handling of an already-requested continuation.
classifications.runtime-owned asynchronous preparation: Built-in replay owns codec and validation promises. Fallback for custom replay contexts preserves the structural API and is outside the ordinary built-in path.
classifications.replay context identity: Production binds identity, version and generation from the activation snapshot. Optional host-specific properties must match this contract.
classifications.duration and retry tuning: Stored default/custom retry and timeout settings are checked; malformed tuning inputs and optional properties can remain visible.
classifications.standalone replay runner outcome: The standalone runner records staged decisions, reports ordinary handler failure, rejects invalid suspension and detects nondeterminism. The production scheduler uses the durable replayer separately.
classifications.Stryker execution limit: The instrumented operation did not settle under the run's external execution limit. Loop/promise behavior is directly exercised by bounded normal tests. This raw status remains distinct from a direct assertion kill.
classifications.empty journal write avoidance: An empty staged batch avoids a journal operation. A different guard can add an empty local append and is not a guarantee about arbitrary custom journals.
classifications.standalone replay history: The journal enforces contiguous command positions; unrelated or malformed history is outside that input contract.
classifications.replay progress: Historical completions and active runtime preparation govern whether to replay more work or suspend. Protective limits and alternative control-flow ordering remain distinguishable.
classifications.activation settling and suspension: Delayed capture encoding, async validation and foreign suspension now have explicit assertions. Runtime preparation can outlive a microtask turn; ordinary application promises still block. Defensive error propagation and protective loop bounds stay raw.
classifications.durable command identity: Runtime-owned primitives generate stable nonempty names. Direct low-level replay can submit a malformed kind or target; any remaining uncovered validation branch stays explicit.
classifications.capture persistence boundary: A delayed value cannot be committed as a placeholder and a completed capture never calls its producer again. Producer exceptions persist as failed capture completions. Codec validation errors retain the pre-commit failure contract. Cancellation and malformed hand-written history have distinct residual behavior.
classifications.durable command completion: Recorded results and typed errors resume in historical order. Missing result and explicitly undefined result differ in internal shape but both resolve undefined.
classifications.durable ordering invariants: History may contain both scheduled and completion events. Built-in adapters provide contiguous command sequences with ordered durable positions; malformed/out-of-order custom history is outside the ordinary adapter contract.
classifications.cancellation replay order: Cancellation preserves already completed work and injects at the durable pending boundary. Pending versus completed peers and post-cancellation compensation are covered by broader primitive suites; index ties or malformed histories remain distinct.
classifications.durable error restoration: Known timeout, cancellation and infrastructure classes retain stored metadata. Fallback sentinel fields for older or malformed history and exact message/stack representation remain visible.
classifications.journal integrity: Unknown IDs reject at the boundary. Different diagnostic wording is not a different journal state.
classifications.standalone replay diagnostics: Error classes, revisions and nondeterminism are tested through the journal runner. Exact English diagnostic formatting is retained as a raw residual.
